Sparkling Tones, part one: connecting to your Spark.
Switch on your Spark, open the app, and tap "Connect". Your phone finds the amp over Bluetooth.
In a moment the app reads the eight presets stored in the amp, all by itself. Red for bank A, green for bank B.
Below them is your library: every other sound you keep, ready to play.
Sparkling Tones: free, and it works offline. Next: your library.
